Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with a COVID-19 indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter indication_label or efo_term for 'COVID-19'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles (via INNER JOIN compound_structures), efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
